steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title while preserving the test's focus on configuration cancellation.
Choose the available RFQ pricing template.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Confirm the product line item exists before reopening configuration.
Reopen the RFQ configuration window from the create screen.
Confirm the Configuration for Event window opened.
Cancel the configuration without applying changes.
Verify that Cancel closes the configuration window.
Verify the product line item remains after cancellation.
Verify the requested quantity remains 10 after cancellation.
Verify the previously selected RFQ template remains applied.
